heropr.logo_usage_guidelines: There's the right way to use the assets
heropr.logo_guideline_1: The length of the Music Minds logo is precisely four times (4X) that of the icon.
heropr.logo_guideline_2: The length of the logo is equal to the height, maintaining a consistent proportion.
heropr.logo_guideline_3: A one-time (1X) border using the icon as a unit, is uniformly applied to the logo in all placements.
heropr.logo_guideline_4: The spacing between the logo mark and the Monotype text is fixed at 1/4th (Y) of the width of the logo mark.
heropr.logo_guideline_5: The logo mark should not be relocated or repositioned under any circumstances.
heropr.logo_guideline_6: Avoid stretching or distorting the font in the logo to maintain its original integrity.
heropr.logo_guideline_7: The window shape of the logo mark must not be altered; should remain consistent.
heropr.logo_guideline_8: Avoid incorporating additional effects such as shadows or glow into the logo for a clean and consistent visual presentation.

story.who_we_are_description: We're not just building an app — we're shaping the future of independent music. Music Minds is a platform born from real creative scenes, built by artists, producers, and educators who understand the hustle. We connect talent with opportunity, learning with practice, and creativity with community. Whether you're a newcomer or an established voice, you belong here.
story.what_we_believe_description: Music is not just content. It's a craft, a process, and a form of expression. We believe talent is everywhere — but access, visibility, and mentoring are not. That's why we created a space where anyone can learn, collaborate, grow, and take ownership of their Music journey.
story.how_we_work_description: We're a lean, international team combining digital innovation with deep cultural insight. We move fast, listen closely, and build for impact. Our approach blends: Human-centered technology, Inclusive user experiences, Scalable learning environments, Feedback-driven development cycles. Every feature is tested with real users. Every decision starts with creator needs.
story.what_drives_us_description1: We've lived the challenges — DIY setups, expensive studio time, limited access, no network. That's why Music Minds exists: to lower the barriers, increase the chances, and shift the power back to the creators.
story.what_drives_us_goal_label: Our long-term goal is simple but bold:
story.what_drives_us_goal: To build the most accessible and trusted platform for independent music production, collaboration, and education — across Europe, Africa, and beyond.
story.what_drives_us_join: Whether you're a beatmaker, songwriter, coach, engineer, or a future headliner — this is your space. Connect. Learn. Build. Share. Let's change the music industry from the inside out.

storycu.why_we_do_this_description: We do this because we know firsthand how much potential lies in people who don’t get a platform. Because we’ve seen how many hours musicians spend searching, comparing, and improvising – instead of doing what matters. Because we believe that technology shouldn't replace but empower
storycu.why_we_do_this_descriptionb: Music Minds was born from our belief that the music industry needs more structure, fairness, and focus.
storycu.what_drives_us_description: We want more great music to be created – regardless of budget, network, or fame. We want collaboration to become professional, plannable, and accessible again. And we want musicians to work with passion without burning themselves out.

storypr.modern_music_description: Music Minds is a digital all-in-one platform for musicians, producers, coaches, studios, and creatives. It enables professional music projects – structured, digital, and collaborative.
storypr.modern_music_descriptionb: The app combines coaching, production, promotion, and project management in one intuitive system. Whether it's vocal lessons, mixing, video production, or marketing: Music Minds efficiently connects musicians and service providers – from idea to release.

code_of_conduct.title: Code of Conduct
code_of_conduct.description: Music Minds is more than a marketplace. It's a community built on trust, creativity, and mutual respect. This Code of Conduct defines how we expect users to behave when using our platform, to ensure a safe, inclusive, and empowering space for all. By using Music Minds, you agree to follow these principles.

list.professionalism: Treat all artists, coaches, producers, and learners with professionalism and kindness.
list.no_harassment: Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, or offensive behavior of any kind will not be tolerated.
list.no_pressure: Do not pressure, insult, or exploit other users — either in communication or transactions.

list.truthful_services: Only offer services you can actually deliver, and represent your skills truthfully.
list.no_fake: Do not create fake accounts, fake reviews, or misleading profiles.
list.clear_communication: Communicate clearly and professionally when booking or being booked.

list.honor_commitments: If you agree to a session or service, honor it — or cancel with reasonable notice.
list.punctuality: End users and providers alike are expected to be on time and prepared.
list.suspension: Missed appointments without valid reason may lead to suspension.

list.no_unauthorized_content: Do not upload or share music, beats, vocals, or samples you do not own or have rights to.
list.respect_work: Respect the creative work of others — including feedback, drafts, and demo files.
list.originality: Music Minds supports original work and protects against plagiarism and content theft.

list.no_circumvention: Do not attempt to circumvent payment systems (e.g., by moving off-platform for deals).
list.ethical_tools: Paid visibility tools must be used ethically — no keyword spam or misleading campaigns.
list.honest_feedback: Feedback systems should reflect real experiences — not be used for retaliation or manipulation.

list.professional_messages: Messages should remain professional and relevant to bookings, learning, or collaboration.
list.no_inappropriate_content: Sexual content, unsolicited promotions, or aggressive tone will lead to immediate action.
list.moderation: Our moderation team reviews flagged content regularly and reserves the right to intervene.

list.no_sharing: Do not share personal information of others without consent.
list.no_unauthorized_recording: Do not record sessions without permission from all parties.
list.confidentiality: Keep platform conversations confidential unless agreed otherwise.

list.culture_of_growth: Contribute to a culture of learning, openness, and growth.
list.diversity: Celebrate diversity — in sound, identity, and origin.

cookies.title: 9. Violations & Consequences
cookies.intro: Music Minds reserves the right to:

list.ban: Permanently ban users in case of serious or repeated violations.

cookies.legal_action: Repeated or serious breaches may result in legal action if applicable.
cookies.report: If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code, please report it via: report@music-minds.io or use the in-app reporting function. Our team treats all reports seriously and confidentially.

childrens-privacy.title: 10. Final Note
childrens-privacy.content: This platform was built to break barriers — not to create new ones. Let's keep Music Minds a safe, collaborative, and empowering space for everyone.
